application_credentials.description: Register a Web application in [Microsoft Entra ID]({console_url}) with this redirect URI: {redirect_url}. Add the delegated user_impersonation permissions for Microsoft Cognitive Services and Azure Service Management. Enter the application's client ID and client secret, not an Azure resource API key. See the integration documentation for permissions and redirect setup.

abort.missing_configuration: Microsoft sign-in is not configured. Add the Entra application client ID and secret in Home Assistant's Application Credentials, then retry.

error.deployment_access_denied: The signed-in user cannot read this resource's deployments. Make sure the app registration has the consented Azure Service Management permission, and grant the user resource-scoped Cognitive Services OpenAI User access.
error.inference_access_denied: The signed-in user can discover models but cannot call Azure OpenAI. Grant resource-scoped Cognitive Services OpenAI User access, or equivalent inference permissions.
error.resource_not_found: The resource was not found in the selected tenant. Check the account resource ID and tenant ID.
error.invalid_resource_id: Enter the ARM resource ID of a Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts resource, not a project ID or URL.
error.invalid_tenant_id: Enter the directory's tenant ID as a UUID.
error.invalid_discovery_response: Azure returned invalid deployment metadata or an unsupported endpoint. Check the resource and retry.
error.no_openai_deployments: No OpenAI deployments were found on this resource. Catalog models that have not been deployed are not added.
error.no_supported_deployments: OpenAI deployments were found, but none expose an API supported by this integration. See the unsupported deployment list.

user.description: Microsoft sign-in discovers deployed OpenAI models and lets you choose which services to add. API-key authentication remains available for manual configuration and API gateways.

menu_options.entra_id: Microsoft Entra ID sign-in and model discovery

api_key.description: Get the endpoint and an API key from the Keys and Endpoint section of your resource in Azure AI Foundry or in the Azure portal.

data_description.api_key: One of the keys of your Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry resource.

entra_id.title: Discover deployed OpenAI models
entra_id.description: Choose the Foundry or Azure OpenAI resource to discover. You will sign in with Microsoft through Home Assistant's Application Credentials. Your user needs inference access and permission to read the account, deployments, and model metadata.

data_description.tenant_id: The tenant UUID from Microsoft Entra ID > Overview.
data_description.resource_id: The account ARM ID from the resource's Azure portal Properties or JSON view, for example /subscriptions/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000/resourceGroups/my-group/providers/Microsoft.CognitiveServices/accounts/my-account. Do not enter a Foundry project ID.

data_description.implementation: Select the Entra application registered for this Home Assistant instance.

discovery.title: Retry deployment discovery

discovery_confirm.title: Choose OpenAI services
discovery_confirm.description:
Services available to add: {service_count}. Select the deployed models to add for each service type; services already added to Home Assistant are not listed. Nothing is selected by default. Existing services, IDs, names, instructions, and customized settings are preserved; leave all fields empty to refresh discovery without adding services. Deleted services stay removed unless explicitly selected again.

Deployments that cannot be added (no supported API, batch-only, or not successfully provisioned):
{unsupported}

No Azure models are deployed or modified.

discovery_all_added.title: All models are already added
discovery_all_added.description:
Every supported model deployed on this resource is already added to Home Assistant for each compatible service, so there is nothing new to add. Existing services and their settings are preserved; continuing only saves the refreshed sign-in and deployment list.

Deployments that cannot be added (no supported API, batch-only, or not successfully provisioned):
{unsupported}

No Azure models are deployed or modified.

reauth_oauth_confirm.description: Sign in with Microsoft again to renew access to the configured Azure resource. Existing services and their options will be preserved.

reauth_confirm.description: Reauthentication required. Please enter your updated API key.

data_description.api_key: One of the keys of your Azure OpenAI or Azure AI Foundry resource.

reconfigure.description: Microsoft sign-in refreshes the deployed-model inventory and lets you choose additional services. It reuses a valid linked account or lets you migrate from an API key. Choose "Update API key or endpoint" to keep manual configuration.

menu_options.entra_id: Microsoft Entra ID and rediscover models

data_description.chat_model: The exact Azure deployment name. With Microsoft sign-in, choices show deployed OpenAI models and their underlying model names.
data_description.recommended: Use recommended advanced settings without changing the selected deployment, sampling, or reasoning effort.
data_description.reasoning_effort: How much reasoning the model performs before responding. Available levels depend on the underlying model; this also applies with recommended settings.
data_description.send_sampling_parameters: Off by default. Temperature and Top P appear only when enabled, and their saved values are kept while disabled. Reasoning models send these parameters only with reasoning effort set to None.
data_description.prompt: Instruct how the LLM should respond. This can be a template.

data_description.reasoning_summary: Controls the length and detail of reasoning summaries provided by the model
data_description.search_context_size: High level guidance for the amount of context window space to use for the search
data_description.user_location: Refine search results based on geography
data_description.verbosity: How detailed the responses of the model should be
data_description.web_search: Allow the model to search the web with Grounding with Bing Search before generating a response. Additional costs apply
